statement:
{a} (aLim : SeqLim a 0) :
  SeqLim (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * n + 1), (-1) ^ k * a k - ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2 * n), (-1) ^ k * a k) 0
name: DiffGoesToZero
content: If `a → 0`, then the difference of odd and even alternating series, `n ↦ ∑ k ∈ range (2n+1), (-1)^k * a k - ∑ k ∈ range (2n), (-1)^k * a k` goes to `0`.
